Same error at commonfactorGWAS.  I just tried a workaround - using userGWAS function and specifying common factor model (in tutorial):

> cfmodel <- 'F1 =~ NA*T1 + T2 + T3
+   F1 ~~ 1*F1
+   F1 ~ SNP'
  > test_userfactor <-userGWAS(covstruc = LDSCoutput, SNPs = test, model = cfmodel, sub=c("F1~SNP"))

3 trait 1-common factor with SNP model.  

Best,
Dan

-Andrew

Best, 
  Andrew
